description:
Shape the Future of Financial Services with Capco

 At Capco, we specialize in management consulting and software development, partnering with leading international banks and insurance companies across Western Europe. Our innovative approach and collaborative culture make us the ideal place for professionals looking to make an impact in financial services technology.

 Want to learn more about our culture and people? Visit us: Capco Careers Slovakia 

 
 Why Join Us? 

 

 
 Prestigious Clients & Exciting Projects – Work with top-tier banks on transformation projects that redefine financial services.

 Continuous Learning & Development – Access to technical and soft skills training, professional certifications, and full access to the Udemy online learning platform.

 Flexible Work Environment – Work from our modern Bratislava office (Nivy Tower) or remotely from home.

 Attractive Benefits Package:
✅ Private health care & paid sick days
✅ 25 vacation days (regardless of age)
✅ Monthly cafeteria allowance (€50/month) or contribution to the 3rd pillar
✅ Fully paid meal vouchers
✅ Multisport card with employer contribution
✅ Smartphone with 1TB data + Laptop
✅ Relaxing office environment: Fresh fruit, game room (PS4, table football), pet-friendly space

 Well-being & Community Engagement – Join yoga lessons, mental health webinars, running challenges, sports activities, or participate in our volunteering days.

 Long-term career – Permanent employment contract with opportunities for career growth.

 The minimum gross monthly base salary for this position is from  € 2,200 . The final offer could be higher to reflect the candidate’s experience, skills, and overall fit for the role. Additionally, this position may also be eligible to receive a discretionary/variable bonus payment. Capco is committed to providing fair and equitable compensation to our people. Our compensation policies are designed to allow our people to progress through our defined salary range over time as they progress in their role.

 
 

 
 Your Role – GenAI Engineer 

 
 Support the development of scalable Python applications focused on GenAI

 Learn and apply techniques like document chunking and embeddings

 Collaborate with the team on building intuitive UIs (Angular/React) and deployment processes (Docker, Terraform, GitHub Actions)

 Work with stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into working code

 Follow coding best practices and contribute to testing and documentation

 
 
 Skills and Expertise 

  

 
 University degree in a relevant field

 Fluent English (German is a plus)

 1–3 years of Python experience

 Interest in GenAI, LLMs, and data search technologies

 Experience with frontend tools (Angular/React) or DevOps tools (Docker, GitHub Actions)

 Eagerness to learn, problem-solve, and collaborate

 
 
 Your Hiring Journey 

 ✅ Screening Call – Introductory chat with our recruiter
✅ Technical Interviews (1-2 rounds, depending on the project ) – Discuss your skills with our experienced Capco colleagues
✅ Feedback & Offer – Receive an offer to join our team!

 
 Why Capco? Because You Matter.

 At Capco, we prioritize your career growth and well-being. You will have a personal coach to support your development and a flat hierarchy that encourages you to share and implement your ideas. Plus, our team events, sports activities, and networking opportunities help you stay connected and engaged beyond work.

 Curious to learn more? Apply now – it only takes 5 minutes!

 📩 Contact: Zora Paulikova – zora.paulikova@capco.com 
💻 Connect on LinkedIn: Zora Paulikova | LinkedIn
